caption:
Everything you’ll find in Rerouted for Christmas. 🚆

Forced proximity across half of Europe. A Black Forest guesthouse with exactly one room left. A grumpy boss who learns to say thank you. And a heroine with one unbreakable rule, and thirteen days left on it.

Which one gets you every time?

slides.subtitle: Swipe if you like your romance snowed in.

slides.heading: Forced proximity
slides.body: Brussels to Zermatt with no jet: a stranded train, the last hire car, and a lot of time side by side.

slides.heading: One room left
slides.body: A guesthouse in the Black Forest. A snowstorm outside. Exactly one room.

slides.heading: Grumpy boss
slides.body: Elliot Hale says “fine” when he means thank you. He’s about to learn some new words.

slides.heading: Her one rule
slides.body: Never with someone who signs her salary. Her notice runs out on the fifth of January.
